summary: No installer-harm behavior observed in leakdeep 2.4.5
details: leakdeep 2.4.5 was scanned and no install-time or import-time behaviors indicative of supply-chain attack were observed. No lifecycle network fetches, no credential or environment scraping, no subprocess execution of fetched content, no hardcoded exfiltration endpoints, and no persistence mechanisms were identified in the package contents.
